llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于增材制造过程监控，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或力学性能评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper only covers in-situ process monitoring of SLM using deep learning, with no mention of implant design, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time defect detection in selective laser melting by analyzing process signatures.
summary_en.method: A deep belief network is applied to classify plume and spatter signatures captured during SLM.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy in identifying abnormal process states.
summary_en.validation: Experimental data from SLM builds are used to validate the classification performance.
